items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Buddy Harper used to be the copyist, and he would copy all the music and Barefield was just turning it out -- we would go to rehearsal

ctx.x: Yeah, he was ... when I was working with Fats, that's when my son was born, and Fats was his Godfather.

As I told you, Al Morgan stayed out here. Well, Eddie Barefield also stayed out here. He left Cab. He jumped ship, as they would say, and you know, he formed a band out here and he had some of the best musicians in the city, and what we would do, he had no job, you know, no idea about getting a job, but the music was so good -- I'll never forget, Buddy Harper used to be the copyist, and he would copy all the music and Barefield was just turning it out -- we would go to rehearsal, and we would have at least three…
Did you know the Indian trombone player named Chief somebody? His name was Chief. *
